failures.criterion: 2. The fold writes each fragment under the version of the release that first shipped it (fold-plan header: the lowest <tag-prefix>X.Y.Z tag that contains the commit which added the fragment).
failures.evidence: A fragment whose file name holds a glob character gets the wrong version. In fold_plan, `git log -1 --diff-filter=A --format=%H HEAD -- "$path"` reads the path as a pathspec pattern. push-fold's own `git rm`/`git add` use --literal-pathspecs, so the two steps read paths differently. Reproduced on a real clone with real tags ($TMPDIR/t629/s1.sh): INFRA-1-[a].yaml was added in c1 and shipped in pi-legion-v99.0.0. INFRA-1-a.yaml was added in c2 and shipped in 99.1.0. fold-plan printed 'packages/pi-legion	99.1.0	…	INFRA-1-[a].yaml', and push-fold landed that entry under '## [99.1.0]'. Red test: .github/scripts/release-push.test.sh, check 'fold-plan: a fragment whose name holds a glob character gets the release of the commit that added that very file' (commit b512ada67210). Command: `bash .github/scripts/release-push.test.sh` → '  FAIL: fold-plan: a fragment whose name holds a glob character …', 'Results: 393 passed, 2 failed'. A throwaway copy of release-push.sh with `git --literal-pathspecs log` passed this check: 394 passed, 0 failed (before the second red test was added).

failures.criterion: 6. The fold runs as a workflow: every run folds everything foldable, and a run that loses a race loses nothing. The fold-plan header says 'the build job and the publish job compute the same plan from the same checkout and tags'.
failures.evidence: That is not true when a release tag is pushed between fold_build and fold_publish. fold_publish's actions/checkout (fetch-depth: 0) fetches every tag again. A release workflow running beside the fold can push a tag in that window: release-envoy-listener.yaml pushes its tag in its publish job, and moves no main. The publish plan then has a group that the build's notes do not have. push-fold exits 1 and the run on main is red. Reproduced ($TMPDIR/t629/s3.sh): the build planned only pi-legion 99.0.0. Then `git tag legion-envoy-v99.0.0 <base>` was run, and push-fold printed '::error::release-push.sh push-fold: …/notes lacks envoy_99.0.0.md', rc=1, origin main unchanged. The next run, which the listener's completion starts, folds the entry, so no entry is lost. But each such race makes a red run on main, and its error suggests that the build job is broken. Red test: .github/scripts/release-push.test.sh, check 'push-fold, a release tag pushed between the jobs: exits 0 and keeps the fragment the notes do not hold' (commit b512ada67210). It asserts only exit 0 and that INFRA-3-third.yaml stays on main. The fix can land the build's plan or push nothing and start a new run. The existing 'fold-missing' refusal (a notes file deleted while the tags did not move) must still refuse. Command: `bash .github/scripts/release-push.test.sh` → '  FAIL: push-fold, a release tag pushed between the jobs: …'.
